summary: Completed full E2E testing of new CareerTrack round: Kanban Board (drag-drop persistence), CSV import/export, themed dark date picker (.rdp), and follow-up reminder badges. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (previous 13 + 4 new for /api/applications/bulk & follow_up_date). Frontend: all requested flows verified against public preview URL using Playwright — demo login->dashboard, followups-due section renders 6 due items, /board shows 5 columns with 10 seeded cards, HTML5 drag-and-drop via dispatch_event moved a card from Applied->Offer, GET confirmed backend PUT persisted (status='Offer'), reload showed card in new column, cards display company logo/pay/follow-up badge (overdue/soon/upcoming). CSV Export triggered a real download (careertrack-applications-2026-08-07.csv). CSV Import via POST /api/applications/bulk created 2 valid rows (TEST_ImportA/B) and correctly skipped a row missing company_name; imported rows appeared in list and were cleaned up. Themed date picker: form-day-applied trigger is a button; clicking opens dark .rdp calendar (react-day-picker), day selection fills the field; form-start-date and form-follow-up buttons present. Backend also seeded 6 apps with follow_up_date (Google, Microsoft, Meta, Stripe, Spotify, Nvidia) all reflected in dashboard follow-ups list. No regressions observed in demo login / add / edit / delete / search / filter / logout.

issues: Recharts still logs 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings on first paint (carried over from iteration 1, cosmetic)
Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning). Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby={undefined-safe id}

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts width/height warnings and add DialogDescription for a11y.

Optional: /api/applications/bulk currently accepts partial successes only when all items pass Pydantic; a single bad item 422s the whole batch. Frontend already skips bad rows client-side, so acceptable, but backend could return per-item errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Board.jsx: uses native HTML5 DnD which is not touch-friendly — consider @dnd-kit or pointer-based fallback for mobile users.
Applications.jsx importCsv: silently skips invalid rows without surfacing which rows were skipped; consider a summary toast (e.g. '2 imported, 1 skipped').
server.py bulk_create_applications: performs N sequential inserts. For large CSVs consider insert_many for perf; also missing per-item validation feedback.

csv.js: parseCSV does not normalise CRLF within quoted fields — currently strips '\r' outside quotes only; edge case for multi-line quoted cells is OK, but the same treatment inside quotes could keep embedded '\r'. Minor.
DatePicker.jsx: no min/max/disabled-days support and no way to clear via keyboard; clearable X is only reachable via mouse.
Dashboard.jsx: dueFollowUps sort key expression is complex/hard to read; extract to a helper for clarity.
Applications.jsx: Edit/Delete buttons still hidden behind group-hover (opacity-0) — poor discoverability on touch devices (carried over from iteration 1).
seed_data_creation: During testing created ephemeral TEST_Bulk1/2 and TEST_ImportA/B applications; all cleaned up. Demo user's 10 seeded apps intact. One card (Uber) was temporarily moved Applied->Offer during DnD test then reset back to Applied.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For Playwright DnD, use locator.dispatch_event('dragstart') then target.dispatch_event('dragenter'|'dragover'|'drop') then source.dispatch_event('dragend'). Playwright's mouse.down/move/up does NOT reliably trigger HTML5 draggable DnD in Chromium. Backend tests: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Prior DnD test 'failure' was tester-side (using DragEvent constructor with dataTransfer via evaluate did not create React-compatible synthetic events); switching to Playwright's locator.dispatch_event fixed the test and confirmed the feature works end-to-end (UI update + PUT persistence + reload survival).
